member.name: T:Gp4Net.Tool.Commands.Applet.DeleteCommand
member.summary:
Command to delete applications or packages from a GlobalPlatform smart card using the functional pipeline pattern. Supports deletion by AID, CAP file extraction, and interactive selection with comprehensive error handling.
This command implements the GlobalPlatform DELETE instruction per Card Specification v2.3.1 with proper cryptographic verification through secure channels. All operations follow the functional architecture pattern using Result<T,E> monads for explicit error handling.

item.description: Delete by specific AID with hex string input
Delete package AID extracted from CAP file
Interactive selection from applications on card
Dry-run mode for safe operation preview
Related object deletion (cascade delete for packages)
Requires established secure channel (SCP02/SCP03)
DELETE command uses authenticated encryption
Proper authentication with card management keys

remarks.para: All GlobalPlatform status words are mapped to human-readable error messages based on the official specification. Common errors include application not found (0x6A82), dependencies exist (0x6985), and security conditions not satisfied (0x6982).

member.summary: Executes the delete command to remove applications or packages from the GlobalPlatform smart card.
member.param: The command execution context providing access to card services and configuration.
The command settings specifying what to delete and how to delete it.
member.returns:
A task representing the asynchronous operation. The result is:
0 if all deletions succeeded
1 if any deletion failed or validation error occurred

remarks.para: This method implements the complete deletion workflow:

item.description: Validates input parameters and determines target AIDs
Displays deletion plan with confirmation (unless forced)
Establishes card connection and secure channel
Executes DELETE commands with progress tracking
Provides detailed success/failure reporting

remarks.para: In dry-run mode, the method stops after displaying the deletion plan without connecting to the card or executing any DELETE commands.
All errors are logged and human-readable error messages are displayed to the user based on GlobalPlatform specification status words.
